name: Clearing Palm
description: Strike a thing with a palm that unmakes its surface and leaves the bare material open.

name: Recast Guard
description: Break the force of a blow and recast it into a plate of qi on the same forearm.

name: Reshaping Step
description: Break the ground at the heel and reshape it into a firm step at the toe.

name: Kiln Flick
description: Flick a bead of unmade stuff that re-forms hard and sharp the moment it lands.

name: Grinding Press
description: Grind the surface of a plated chest to powder and press the powder back into the flesh.

name: Mould Unmaking
description: Unmake the ground at the foe's feet and mould it again so that it closes about his legs.

name: Remaking Remedy
description: Unmake a binding curse on an ally and remake the clean line of the qi it had twisted.

name: Crucible Thrust
description: Thrust unmaking qi through a guard and remake the broken pieces as spikes that hold it open.

name: Smelting Surge
description: Send a surge that unmakes gear into molten slag and sets it hard about the foes.

name: Reforging Ward
description: Unmake each blow against the ward and reforge its force into strength for the user.

name: Forge Collapse
description: Collapse every structure in a ring and let the debris reset into cages about the foes.

name: Creative Ruin
description: streams: Destruction + Creation; unmake a foe's guard and remake its pieces as a hold that binds him.

name: Scrap Palm
description: Strike an object with a palm that breaks it to useful scrap.

name: Salvage Guard
description: Take a blow on a forearm that gathers the shards of the weapon into a guard plate.

name: Scrapwork Step
description: Break the ground behind and lay the broken stone ahead as a firm run of steps.

name: Splinter Seed
description: Flick a splinter of unmaking that roots in the foe's gear and keeps breaking it.

name: Dismantling Grasp
description: Take a foe's weapon apart in his hands and grow its pieces into a cage about the wrists.

name: Remaking Thrust
description: Thrust through a guard and leave a new thin spike where the guard was.

name: Unmaking Renewal
description: Unmake a clinging taint in an ally and renew the clean flow of qi where it sat.

name: Clearing Quell
description: Clear the foe's gathering qi away and let nothing new take root in its place.

name: Fertile Ruin
description: Ruin a wide patch of ground and sow it with hard crystals that grow on the foes.

name: Seed Breach
description: Breach a thick ward and leave a seed of new matter lodged in the gap.

name: Clearing Renewal
description: Clear a deep curse from an ally entirely and set new clean flow in its place.

name: Spire Breaking
description: Break the ground of a wide ring and raise new spires of stone from the broken earth.

name: Unmade Genesis
description: streams: Destruction + Creation; unmake a whole structure and let it be born again as a new thing of the user's choosing.

name: Shattered Origin
description: streams: Destruction + Creation; shatter a foe's guard to its first principle and make a new guard from it.
